caption: The video captures a fixed night view of a snow-covered outdoor shopping promenade decorated for the holidays. On the left, a Starbucks storefront glows beneath striped awnings. On the right, a hanging 'CHEEZED' sign sits beside a garland wrapped in warm lights and topped with a red bow. In the foreground, snow-laden tables, stacked chairs, and a closed umbrella sit motionless behind a black railing. Two pedestrians in dark winter coats occupy the left-center walkway and steadily recede from the camera, their figures shrinking as perspective draws them toward the image's center. Snowflakes drift continuously down through the sky and across the scene. In the distance, an illuminated Christmas tree and glowing cone-shaped structures twinkle and pulse in brightness.
